bitfield.description: Active 32 bit Counter register which is used as the Capture time-base Reset Source: vbus_rst_mod_g_rst_n

Counter phase value register that can be programmed for phase Lag/Lead. This register shadows the ECAP_TSCNT register and is loaded into the ECAP_TSCNT register upon either a SYNCI event or software force via a control bit.Used to achieve phase control sync with respect to other ECAP and EPWM time-bases. Reset Source: vbus_rst_mod_g_rst_n

This register can be loaded (written) by:1. Time-Stamp (counter value) during a capture event.2. Software - may be useful for test purposes/initialisation.3. APRD shadow register (ECAP_CAP3) when used in APWM mode. Reset Source: vbus_rst_mod_g_rst_n

This register can be loaded (written) by:1. Time-Stamp (counter value) during a capture event.2. Software - may be useful for test purposes.3. ACMP shadow register (ECAP_CAP4) when used in APWM mode. Reset Source: vbus_rst_mod_g_rst_n

In CMP mode this is a time-stamp capture register.In APMW mode this is the period shadow (APER) register.User updates the PWM period value via this register.In this mode the ECAP_CAP3 (APRD) register shadows the ECAP_CAP1 register. Reset Source: vbus_rst_mod_g_rst_n

In CMP mode this is a time-stamp capture register.In APMW mode this is the compare shadow (ACMP) register.User updates the PWM Compare value via this register.In this mode the ECAP_CAP4 (ACMP) register shadows the ECAP_CAP2 register. Reset Source: vbus_rst_mod_g_rst_n
Reset Source: vbus_rst_mod_g_rst_n
APWM Output Polarity Select:Note: This is applicable only in APWM operating mode. 0h Output is Active High (Compare value defines High time)1h Output is Active Low (Compare value defines Low time)

CAP/APWM Operating Mode Select: 0h ECAP module operates in Capture mode. This mode forces the following configuration: 1. Inhibits the ECAP_TSCNT register resets via PRD event. 2. Inhibits the Shadow loads on the ECAP_CAP1 and ECAP_CAP2 registers. 3. Permits user to enable the ECAP_CAP1 to ECAP_CAP4 register load. 4. CAPx/APWMx pin operates as a Capture input.1h ECAP module operates in APWM mode. This mode forces the following configuration: 1. Resets the ECAP_TSCNT register on PRD event (period boundary) 2. Permits Shadow loading on the ECAP_CAP1 and ECAP_CAP2 registers. 3. Disables loading of Time-stamps into the ECAP_CAP1 - ECAP_CAP4 registers 4. CAPx/APWMx pin operates as a APWM output.

Software Forced Counter (ECAP_TSCNT) Synchronizing: 0h Writing a zero has no effect. Reading will always return a zero.1h Writing a one will force a ECAP_TSCNT shadow load of current ECAP module and any ECAP modules down-stream providing the SYNCO_SEL bits are 0h

SyncOut Select:Note: Selection PRD is meaningful only in APWM mode, however can still be chosen in CAP mode if user believes it to be useful. 0h Select SyncIn event to be the SyncOut signal (pass through)1h Select PRD event to be the SyncOut signal2h Disable SyncOut Signal3h Disable SyncOut Signal
Counter (ECAP_TSCNT) SyncIn select mode: 0h Disable SyncIn option1h Enable Counter (ECAP_TSCNT) to be loaded from the ECAP_CNTPHS register upon either a SYNCI signal or a software force event.
Counter Stop (freeze) Control: 0h Counter Stopped1h Counter Free Running

One-Shot Re-arming Control Wait for stop trigger: 0h Has no effect. Reading always returns a 0h1h Arms the One-Shot sequence: 1. Resets the Mod4 counter to zero. 2. Un-freezes the Mod4 counter. 3. Enables Capture Register Loads.

Stop Value for One-Shot Mode:This is the number (between 1 and 4) of captures allowed to occur before the ECAP_CAP1 through ECAP_CAP4 registers are frozen (capture sequence is stopped).Notes: [1] STOPVALUE is compared to Mod4 counter, when equal, two actions occur:1. Mod4 Counter is stopped (frozen)2. Capture register loads are inhibited[2] In one shot mode, further interrupt events are blocked until we re-arm, once the number of events captured has been reached. 0h Stop after Capture Event 11h Stop after Capture Event 22h Stop after Capture Event 33h Stop after Capture Event 4
Continuous or One-shot Mode Control (applicable only in Capture mode): 0h Operate in Continuous mode1h Operate in One-Shot mode
Emulation Control 0h ECAP_TSCNT Counter stops immediately on emulation suspend1h ECAP_TSCNT Counter runs until = 0h3h ECAP_TSCNT Counter is unaffected by emulation suspend (Run Free)
Event Filter Prescale Select: 0h Divide by 1 (no prescale, by-pass the prescaler)1Eh Divide by 601Fh Divide by 621h Divide by 22h Divide by 43h Divide by 64h Divide by 85h Divide by 10

Enable Loading of the ECAP_CAP1 to ECAP_CAP4 registers on a capture event: 0h Disable ECAP_CAP1 to ECAP_CAP4 register loads at capture event time.1h Enable ECAP_CAP1 to ECAP_CAP4 register loads at capture event time.
Counter Reset on Capture Event 4: 0h Do Not reset Counter on Capture Event 4 (absolute time stamp)1h Reset counter after Event 4 time-stamp has been captured (used in Difference mode operation)
Capture Event 4 Polarity Select: 0h Capture event 4 triggered on a Rising Edge (RE)1h Capture event 4 triggered on a Falling Edge (FE)
Counter Reset on Capture Event 3: 0h Do not reset counter on Capture Event 3 (absolute time stamp)1h Reset counter after Event 3 time-stamp has been captured (used in difference mode operation)
Capture Event 3 Polarity Select: 0h Capture event 3 triggered on a Rising Edge (RE)1h Capture event 3 triggered on a Falling Edge (FE)
Counter Reset on Capture Event 2: 0h Do not reset counter on Capture Event 2 (absolute time stamp)1h Reset Counter after Event 2 time-stamp has been captured (used in difference mode operation)
Capture Event 2 Polarity Select: 0h Capture event 2 triggered on a Rising Edge (RE)1h Capture event 2 triggered on a Falling Edge (FE)
Counter Reset on Capture Event 1: 0h Do not reset counter on Capture Event 1 (absolute time stamp)1h Reset counter after Event 1 time-stamp has been captured (used in difference mode operation)
Capture Event 1 Polarity Select: 0h Capture event 1 triggered on a Rising Edge (RE)1h Capture event 1 triggered on a Falling Edge (FE)
Compare Equal Status Flag:Note: This flag is only active in APWM mode. 0h Indicates no event occurred1h Indicates the counter (ECAP_TSCNT) reached the Compare register value (ACMP)
Period Equal Status Flag:Note: This flag is only active in APWM mode. 0h Indicates no event occurred1h Indicates the Counter (ECAP_TSCNT) reached the Period register value (APER) and was reset.
Counter Overflow Status Flag:Note: This flag is active in CAP and APWM mode. 0h Indicates no event occurred.1h Indicates the Counter (ECAP_TSCNT) has made the transition from FFFF FFFFh to 0000 0000h
Capture Event 4 Status Flag:Note: This flag is only active in CAP mode. 0h Indicates no event occurred.1h Indicates the fourth event occurred at ECAPx pin.
Capture Event 3 Status Flag:Note: This flag is only active in CAP mode. 0h Indicates no event occurred.1h Indicates the third event occurred at ECAPx pin.
Capture Event 2 Status Flag:Note: This flag is only active in CAP mode. 0h Indicates no event occurred.1h Indicates the second event occurred at ECAPx pin.
Capture Event 1 Status Flag:Note: This flag is only active in CAP mode. 0h Indicates no event occurred.1h Indicates the first event occurred at ECAPx pin.
Global Interrupt Status Flag: 0h Indicates no interrupt generated.1h Indicates that an interrupt was generated from one of the following events.
Compare Equal Interrupt Enable: 0h Disabled Compare Equal as an Interrupt source1h Enable Compare Equal as an Interrupt source
Period Equal Interrupt Enable: 0h Disabled Period Equal as an Interrupt source1h Enable Period Equal as an Interrupt source
Counter Overflow Interrupt Enable: 0h Disabled Counter Overflow as an Interrupt source1h Enable Counter Overflow as an Interrupt source
Capture Event 4 Interrupt Enable: 0h Disabled Capture Event 4 as an Interrupt source:1h Enable Capture Event 4 as an Interrupt source
Capture Event 3 Interrupt Enable: 0h Disabled Capture Event 3 as an Interrupt source:1h Enable Capture Event 3 as an Interrupt source
Capture Event 2 Interrupt Enable: 0h Disabled Capture Event 2 as an Interrupt source:1h Enable Capture Event 2 as an Interrupt source
Capture Event 1 Interrupt Enable: 0h Disabled Capture Event 1 as an Interrupt source:1h Enable Capture Event 1 as an Interrupt source
Force Compare Equal: 0h No effect. Always reads back a 0h1h Writing a 1h to this bit will set the CMPEQ_FLG flag bit.
Force Period Equal: 0h No effect. Always reads back a 0.1h Writing a 1h to this bit will set the PRDEQ_FLG flag bit.
Force Counter Overflow: 0h No effect. Always reads back a 0.1h Writing a 1h to this bit will set the CNTOVF_FLG flag bit.
Force Capture Event 4: 0h No effect. Always reads back a 0.1h Writing a 1h to this bit will set the CEVT4_FLG flag bit.
Force Capture Event 3: 0h No effect. Always reads back a 0.1h Writing a 1h to this bit will set the CEVT3_FLG flag bit.
Force Capture Event 2: 0h No effect. Always reads back a 0.1h Writing a 1h to this bit will set the CEVT2_FLG flag bit.
Force Capture Event 1: 0h No effect. Always reads back a 0.1h Writing a 1h to this bit will set the CEVT1_FLG flag bit.
Compare Equal Status Flag: 0h No effect. Always reads back a 0.1h Writing a 1h will clear the CMPEQ_FLG flag condition.
Period Equal Status Flag: 0h No effect. Always reads back a 0.1h Writing a 1h will clear the PRDEQ_FLG flag condition.
Counter Overflow Status Flag: 0h No effect. Always reads back a 0.1h Writing a 1h will clear the CNTOVF_FLG flag condition.
Capture Event 4 Status Flag: 0h No effect. Always reads back a 0.1h Writing a 1h will clear the CEVT4_FLG flag condition.
Capture Event 3 Status Flag: 0h No effect. Always reads back a 0.1h Writing a 1h will clear the CEVT3_FLG flag condition.
Capture Event 2 Status Flag: 0h No effect. Always reads back a 0.1h Writing a 1h will clear the CEVT2_FLG flag condition.
Capture Event 1 Status Flag: 0h No effect. Always reads back a 0.1h Writing a 1h will clear the CEVT1_FLG flag condition.
Global Interrupt Clear Flag: 0h No effect. Always reads back a 0.1h Writing a 1h will clear the INT_FLG flag and enable further interrupts to be generated if any of the event flags are set to 1h.
